name: Netlify
description: Netlify REST API for managing sites, atomic deploys, forms, DNS and snippets.
auth_notes: Personal access tokens sent as Authorization: Bearer; OAuth2 required for public integrations, using an application client key and secret.
gate_detail: Developers generate a personal access token in Applications settings, or register an OAuth application in user settings. No plan restriction on API access is stated; SSO teams need explicit token grant. No sandbox stated.
api_scope: REST API at api.netlify.com/api/v1 to manage atomic deploys, form submissions, JavaScript snippets, DNS and sites.
mcp_notes: No source mentions an MCP server for Netlify.
blocker_detail: No payment or approval gate stated; SAML SSO teams require granting token access at creation.

evidence.quote: Go to Applications > Personal access tokens .
To authenticate API requests, include the token in the authorization header:
If you’re making a public integration with Netlify for others to enjoy, you must use OAuth2.
Use the Netlify REST API to manage atomic deploys of your sites and apps, manage form submissions, inject JavaScript snippets, manage DNS

issues: Plan requirements for API use are not explicitly stated.
Webhooks, sandbox and MCP are not covered by the sources.
